nodes.label: short chain fatty acid esterification
nodes.def: Esterification of minor organic_acid_substrates including propionic and butyric acids by lactobacillus_esterase_activity, producing corresponding ethyl esters with distinctive pung

nodes.label: slowed metabolism
nodes.def: Diminished microbial activity state where wild_yeast and lactobacillus consume minimal resources.

nodes.label: soaker
nodes.def: Technique of soaking grains and seeds in liquid overnight to soften hulls, reduce phytic acid, and improve digestibility.

nodes.label: sourdough baker
nodes.def: Person practicing sourdough bread making with emphasis on starter cultivation and fermentation

nodes.label: sourdough flavor
nodes.def: Complex taste profile combining sour tang, wheat notes, and fermentation-derived compounds varying with starter age and fermentation time.

nodes.label: sourdough starter culture
nodes.def: Living microbial community of yeast and bacteria passed between batches
